tools.name: get_training_requirements
tools.description: Use this before training an AI voice to confirm NiceVois input formats, duration and epoch limits, consent requirements, outputs, retention, and the exact upload workflow.

tools.name: get_training_account
tools.description: Call before quoting or creating a training job. Returns the connected account's welcome-credit status, available and reserved balance, balance packs, and a private browser link that keeps checkout on this same agent identity.

tools.name: quote_training
tools.description: Call after inspecting the audio and before creating a job. Returns the exact payable amount, current balance, welcome-credit effect, shortfall, feasibility, and the private balance-page link when more balance is needed.

tools.name: create_training_job
tools.description: Creates a private NiceVois job and returns a one-time PUT upload URL. Do not ask for consent before the first attempt because NiceVois remembers the current standing account agreement. If the server returns CONSENT_REQUIRED, ask for one acceptance of the linked standing agreement and retry once with

tools.name: start_training
tools.description: Use this only after the source audio was successfully PUT to the upload URL returned by create_training_job. Starts the private cloud RVC training job.

tools.name: get_training_job
tools.description: Use this to check truthful stage, completed epochs, ETA, and artifact readiness for one private NiceVois training job. Poll reasonably; do not call more often than every 15 seconds.

tools.name: list_training_jobs
tools.description: Use this to find the authenticated user's recent NiceVois jobs before asking for a job ID they may not know.

tools.name: get_conversion_requirements
tools.description: Use this when a user wants to convert vocals with RVC or compare a normal RVC result with NiceVois cleaned consonants and breaths. Returns the real input formats, model choices, workflow, current free-beta policy, and outputs.

tools.name: list_voice_models
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to convert audio and you need to select one of their private NiceVois-trained or uploaded RVC voices. Do not ask for a model ID before calling this tool.

tools.name: create_voice_model_import
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to convert with an existing private RVC .pth file or complete model ZIP instead of a voice trained in their NiceVois library. Returns a one-time PUT upload instruction. After uploading, call list_voice_models to select the imported voice.

tools.name: create_voice_conversion
tools.description: Use this when the user has selected a private voice model and wants to convert one vocal recording. Returns a private upload instruction. Upload only the source vocal, then call get_voice_conversion with the same conversion ID. Creating it counts one of the account's conversions (three free per acco

tools.name: get_voice_conversion
tools.description: Use this when checking one private NiceVois conversion. Poll no more than once every 10 seconds. Report the returned stage without inventing progress. When complete, present the NiceVois cleaned version first and use download_voice_conversion_output for the version the user requests.

tools.name: download_voice_conversion_output
tools.description: Use after get_voice_conversion says the job is complete and the user wants the cleaned or standard output. Downloads are free; the conversion was counted once when it started. If the exact file was downloaded before, ask before retrying and then set confirmRepeat true.

tools.name: list_free_audio_tools
tools.description: Use this to see NiceVois's free audio tools (discovery needs no account; processing shares your account allowance): split a song into vocals and instrumental (vocal remover, acapella, karaoke instrumental), split lead vocals from backing vocals, remove background noise, and remove reverb or echo. Re

tools.name: create_free_audio_job
tools.description: Split stems, isolate vocals, or remove noise or reverb using the same account allowance as the website. Connect a free account with OAuth or an agent key. No paid subscription is required for the free allowance. Returns an upload URL, then use get_free_audio_job.

tools.name: get_free_audio_job
tools.description: Use this after create_free_audio_job and the upload, no more than every 10 seconds, until the job is completed or failed. When it completes, it lists every output file (for example lead vocal, backing vocals, instrumental) with a download link.

tools.name: create_audio_job
tools.description: Every NiceVois audio tool. With a connected account it runs on that account (a subscriber's unlimited use applies): split_stems, split_lead_backing, remove_noise, remove_reverb, enhance_vocal (Vocal Enhancer, Lite and Unlimited), generate_harmony (upper and lower harmonies from a solo lead vocal). c

tools.name: get_audio_job
tools.description: Use after create_audio_job and the upload, until the job is completed or failed. When complete it lists each output; call get_audio_download for the ones the user wants.

tools.name: get_audio_download
tools.description: Returns a short-lived link to one output of a completed audio job. Download it or give it to the user straight away.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_voice_models" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this when the user wants to convert audio and you need to select one of their private NiceVois-trained or uploaded RVC voices. Do not ask for a model ID bef…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_voice_conversion" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this when the user has selected a private voice model and wants to convert one vocal recording. Returns a private upload instruction. Upload only the source vocal, then call get_voice_conversion with the same conversion ID." → after: "Use this when the user has selected a private voice model and wants to convert one vocal recording. Returns a private upload instruction. Upload only the source vocal, then call get_voice_conversion with the same conversion ID. Creating it counts one of the account's conversions (three free per acco"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
